parameters.help_en:
The key of the tag option.

The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
用户输入的标签选项键。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
